R1_parser_admitted.evidence: Input admitted as HEIF; metadata-block enumeration loop entered. Necessarily executed because downstream in-loop frames (set_blob@heifload.c:470 crash-stack frame 7, get_metadata@440 alloc-stack frame 2) are only reachable after this enumeration. Line confirmed in vul source.

R2_source_reached.evidence: Allocation of the 1-byte block at heifload.c:440 (alloc-stack frame 2) sits between the size read (428) and the byte copy (442) in straight-line code within the same executed frame; the block bytes must have been materialized for the EXIF parse to run. Lines confirmed in vul source (428,440,442).

R3_vulnerable_function_reached.evidence: Present as ASan crash-stack frame 7 (heifload.c:470) and allocation-stack frame 2 (heifload.c:440). Directly observed.

R4_vulnerable_line_reached.evidence: Crash geometry: faulting read at base+4 of a 1-byte region directly witnesses `data += 4` executed; libexif's `ds < 6` guard being bypassed witnesses the `length -= 4` size_t underflow. Corroborated by patch_differential (fix adds the `length > 4` guard at fix heifload.c:483-484 and the PoC then exits clean). Not read from a call stack (it is straight-line code between alloc@442 and set_blob@470) but observed via the crash's memory offset + guard bypass, not deduced from dominance.

R5_sink_reached.evidence: The ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ 6 fires exactly here (crash-stack frame 2). This is the observed sink.

root_cause_differential.vul_run: n132/arvo:26524-vul '/bin/arvo run' => exit 1, heap-buffer-overflow READ 6 at exif-data.c:862
root_cause_differential.fix_run: n132/arvo:26524-fix '/bin/arvo run' => exit 0, 'Executed /tmp/poc in 198 ms' (no ASan error)
root_cause_differential.fix_change: heifload.c exif branch changed from `if( g_ascii_strcasecmp( type, "exif" ) == 0 ) { data += 4; length -= 4; }` (vul 452-454) to `if( length > 4 && g_ascii_strcasecmp( type, "exif" ) == 0 ) { data += 4; length -= 4; }` (fix 483-486). The added `length > 4` guard is the fix; it matches ground_truth root_cause.
root_cause_differential.evidence: Same PoC, opposite outcomes across vul/fix images => the missing `length > 4` bounds check is the causal root cause.

intermediate_taint.reason: Byte-level DFSan taint (-fsanitize=dataflow + harness change) not run on this emulated qemu host; defer to native amd64. Structural data flow corroborated by crash geometry (base+4) and the ds<6 bypass.

Re-materialize the commit that adds `if( length > 4 && g_ascii_strcasecmp( type, "exif" ) == 0 )`. This is an input-artifact fix, not a GT-content fix. Runtime validation used the fix Docker image, which contains the correct fix, so root_cause_confirmed is sound.

verdict.summary: All GT invariant nodes/edges are runtime-consistent and falsifiable. Sink (exif-data.c:862), alloc (heifload.c:440), and the propagation chain are directly observed in the ASan report; root_cause (missing `length > 4` guard, heifload.c:454) is confirmed by both crash geometry (read at base+4) and patch differential (vul crash / fix clean). No node required revision; nothing refuted. Only defects are in the input patch.diff artifact (docs-only commit), which does not affect GT content — flagged for re-materialization.
